$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-decimal-bintype.xml (Rule 10, D-030). BinType=Decimal, the ONLY whitespace-separated bin type: its tokens are exactly three digits, 000..255, and concatenating them is E142_BIN_BAD_TOKEN on re-read while the fixed-width types have no separators at all. That asymmetry is the format's, not the decoder's, and it is what D-029 was about - a serializer that dropped the separators here produced a document that could not be read back. NullBin is 255, not 000, so the null token is not the numeric zero and a reader that assumed otherwise reads four corner cells as data.
